svg.title: How to order at WaGen Malatang
svg.desc: 1. Grab a bowl and tongs. 2. Pick your favorite ingredients; the minimum charge is 300 g. 3. Choose your soup or dry mix from five flavors. 4. Pay at the counter and collect your pager. 5. Relax while we cook; sauces and chilled water are self-service. 6. Collect your bowl when paged. 7. Enjoy while it is hot and return your dishes after your meal.

g.text: Find them on the shelf by the entrance.
Fill your bowl with the ingredients you love.
For hygiene, please do not return ingredients
Choose your soup or dry mix
Take a seat while we prepare your bowl.
Sauces and chilled water are self-service.
Bring your pager to the counter and
Please return your dishes after your meal.
